jsonLd.description: Professional custom software development company in Lucknow. We expertise in developing ERPs, CRMs, Hospital Management Systems, Real Estate software, and custom automated billing solutions.

mainEntity.name: What technologies do you use for software development?

acceptedAnswer.text: At Auctech IT Solutions, we utilize modern and highly stable tech stacks. Our backend expertise includes PHP (Laravel/CodeIgniter), Node.js, and Python, while our frontend spans React, Vue.js, and angular. We deploy on top-tier cloud providers like AWS and Google Cloud to ensure 99.9% uptime.

mainEntity.name: Will I own the source code of my custom software?

acceptedAnswer.text: Absolutely. Once the project is fully completed and outstanding invoices are cleared, we transfer 100% intellectual property rights and the complete source code to your business as per our contract terms.

mainEntity.name: How much does custom software development cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost entirely depends on the complexity, scale, and features required. A simple billing software will cost significantly less than an enterprise-grade Hospital Management System. We provide free, transparent, and highly detailed scopes of work and pricing estimates before you commit.

mainEntity.name: Can you integrate my existing tools and databases?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. A critical part of our service involves securely bridging new software with your legacy systems, payment gateways, and third-party APIs (like WhatsApp API, MailChimp, existing ERP solutions, etc.) to ensure a seamless operational flow.

mainEntity.name: Do you provide post-launch support and maintenance?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, we provide continuous technical support, bug tracking, feature scaling, and general maintenance packages (SLAs). We don’t just launch your software; we make sure it runs optimally 24/7/365.

mainEntity.name: Does custom software development take a long time?

acceptedAnswer.text: Developing custom software depends on the scale. An MVP (Minimum Viable Product) can take 2-3 months, while complex enterprise suites can take 6 months. We break down the project into agile milestones for early deliverables.

mainEntity.name: Can you upgrade my existing legacy software?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We can refactor existing code, optimize database performance, migrate your legacy systems to the cloud, and modernize outdated interfaces without losing historic data.

mainEntity.name: Will my custom software be mobile compatible?

acceptedAnswer.text: We specialize in building responsive web applications that work perfectly on mobile browsers, as well as developing dedicated native or cross-platform mobile apps for iOS and Android.
